text.en:
Appendix A, Project No. B-412.72, page eight hundred twenty-six-A of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and thirteen, is hereby amended by merely deleting the words "Perez Boulevard" to read as follows:
"Pantal Bridge, Dagupan City ₱300,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1957.
